chars.HERO: HERO: a short slim Moroccan young man (27, noticeably short), curly black hair, thin moustache, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans, white sneakers
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a petite Moroccan young woman (25), long wavy brown hair, wearing a lilac puffer jacket over a cream sweater and black trousers
chars.AUDI: AUDI: a tall arrogant Moroccan young man (28), slicked-back hair, trimmed beard, wearing a black leather jacket, white t-shirt, gold chain, dark sunglasses
chars.MOM: MOM: a warm Moroccan mother in her fifties wearing a green djellaba and a beige headscarf
chars.DAD: DAD: a Moroccan father in his late fifties, grey hair and moustache, wearing a brown wool cardigan over a checked shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Outside a tiny print and photocopy shop in Ifrane, Morocco (pine trees, sloped red roofs). The short HERO stands proudly next to GIRL, while AUDI leans on a shiny black Audi sedan right beside them, smirking down at HERO and flexing his car keys; HERO glares up at him, GIRL looks between them awkwardly. Comic tension, height difference obvious.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Cosy Moroccan living room with salon cushions. MOM hugs HERO with joyful tears while DAD pats his shoulder proudly, all smiling.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside the small print shop with photocopiers and a counter: HERO happily counts a small stack of dirham banknotes behind the counter, customers' papers piled up, warm light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan jewellery shop, HERO excitedly holds up a small open ring box with a gold ring, imagining a surprise, big hopeful smile.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, small bedroom: HERO lies awake on his bed in the dark, phone light on his face, daydreaming and smiling, a calculator and notebook beside him.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moody ominous shot: HERO alone at the print shop counter at dusk, looking out the glass door with a sudden uneasy feeling, cold blue light, long shadows.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Daytime inside the print shop: HERO calmly takes printed sheets out of a big photocopier, routine work, the glass shop front and the snowy Ifrane street visible behind him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: View through the print shop glass front: a shiny black Audi sedan rolls slowly past on the street, AUDI at the wheel with sunglasses smirking; inside, HERO freezes with papers falling from his hands, mouth open. The car's passenger seat is hidden by a strong sun reflection.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of HERO pressed against the shop glass, eyes wide in shock, staring at the black car driving away outside; the car windows are dark and reflective so nobody inside is visible.
